notes.title: Update 1.12.2 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi all, 

Update 1.12.2 is now available for CMANO, Northern Inferno and Chains of War! 

[b]1.12.2 changelog:[/b]
* FIXED: Unit may not go out of comms if all onboard comm devices are destroyed. 
* FIXED: Excessive delay in opening DB viewer. 
* FIXED: When resuming from campaign checkpoint-save, it was possible to play only in "standalone" mode, not "campaign" mode

* Fixed the "I accidentally added a railgun/laser/Tac-EMP weapon/platform to a scenario [prior to v1.12], and now I get blocked from loading it because I don't have a CoW license" problem.

notes.title: 1.09 Hotfix is now available
notes.content:
A hotfix for the steam version of Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations and Command: Northern Inferno is now available. This hotfix should fix the license issues some people were experiencing and will get everyone access to the content they have bought a license for.

The patch will be updated automatically by the Steam client. If that is not the case, please try and restart your client.

We would like to thank those who downloaded the beta patch and helped us test it. You can now opt out of the beta program again in the same way you opted in. Just select the “None – Opt out of betas” option.

If you are facing any more issues after installing this patch, please let us know and describe the circumstances in which the bug occurred as detailed as possible.

Thank you for your support.

Surtur

notes.title: 1.09 Beta Patch is now available
notes.content:
As some of you are facing issues with the license checks for Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations and Command: Northern Inferno, we have created a beta patch that we hope may fix the issues. 

We’re not sure why it is happening but we swapped the order 2 lines of code are executed and we think this may help. It might sounds silly but we suspect this order is what’s causing the issue but as we can’t repeat it here we can’t be sure and need your help to validate it. 

We need as many people as possible to try this patch. Even if the game was working before, we need to know it’s still working! It works fine for us, but it did before too so we can’t validate its fixed. 

To get the beta patch follow these instructions. It’s very simple to do so don’t worry if you are not technical! Here are step by step instructions. 

- Go to your steam games library in the steam client

- Right click on the game - Command (NI or CMANO, whichever you use) and select properties
Note the tabs across the top – select the beta tab

- From the drop down list of betas select the "Beta"

This will queue the beta update (its very small only a few MB so will be quick once it starts)
In your game library the name of the game will have (Public Beta) appended to it to show you have the beta version. 

If the download does not start you may have to exit steam and reload it to force it. 

You can also sometimes force it by going to the list of downloads and forcing the update to apply. 

Whenever you want to opt out of the beta follow the instructions above, and from the drop down list just select None – opt out of betas. 

Please let us know if this beta patch fixes your issues and we will make it public. If your problems are not addressed, please let us know (in as much detail as possible!) what error messages you are getting and what you were trying to do at this point. 

We are sorry for the issues introduced with this patch and we are dedicated to bringing a fix to everyone who is experiencing the licensing issues.

Thanks for your help in resolving this – we really appreciate it!

The Slitherine & Warfaresims Teams

- Surtur

notes.title: The scenarios of Northern Inferno
notes.content:
As you probably know by now, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/397180]Northern Inferno[/url] is coming this Thursday as part of the massive v1.09 update. The first DLC pack for Command, NI is also important as its standalone nature allows players to purchase and enjoy it regardless of whether they already own CMANO or not.

Let’s peruse the 15 scenarios that comprise this epic WW3 campaign. Each scenario can be played either as part of the campaign (in which case reaching a certain “pass score” is necessary in order to advance to the next scenario) or in standalone mode like all other CMANO scenarios.

Here is the list:

1) [b]Opening Moves[/b]: Soviet submarines are rushing across the Norwegian Sea, heading for the Greenland-Iceland-UK (GIUK) gap, doorway to the Atlantic. NATO naval forces mobilize to stem the tide.

2) [b]Goblin on the doorstep[/b]: Amidst the growing crisis, the British strategic nuclear submarine HMS Revenge is putting out to sea. Soviet strategic doctrine dictates targeting and destroying these invaluable assets as soon as possible during a crisis or war. It’s a long way out to the safety of deep water…

3) [b]The Fast and the Furious[/b]: The war is spreading. A powerful Soviet amphibious force is heading towards northern Norway, screened by multiple squadrons of missile fast-attack craft. With the bulk of NATO’s Atlantic forces already committed elsewhere, what can Norway do to blunt the invasion?

4) [b]Barents Sea Boomers[/b]: After absorbing punch after punch, NATO swings to the offensive by applying one of the key tenets of the 1980′s Maritime Strategy: Hunt down and attempt to sink the Soviet strategic submarines (SSBNs) inside their protective bastions.

5) [b]Beware of the Badger[/b]: Norway has been invaded. The US and UK are rushing heavy amphibious forces to support the bulwark in the north. But the Soviet Naval Aviation’s missile-armed bombers roam over the Norwegian Sea. Will enough reinforcements reach Norway to matter?

6) [b]The Grey Ghost from the East Coast[/b]: Taking a page out of the WW2 Kriegsmarine playbook, the Soviet Navy is sending its Sverdlov heavy cruisers down the Denmark strait, bypassing the battered Icelandic defences, in hopes of further straining NATO’s overburdened Atlantic screen. Standing in their way is a USN surface group centered around the Newport News, the US Navy’s last heavy-gun cruiser. Can the “Grey Ghost” and her cohorts crash the Sverdlov raiding party?

7) [b]The Mighty O[/b]: Iceland has been heavily bombarded and then seized by Soviet forces. Soon, Soviet naval bombers will be able to operate from the polar island’s airbases, striking at will all over the Atlantic. For NATO, this is unacceptable – and the carrier Oriskany will spearhead the operation to shut Iceland down.

8) [b]Damn The Torpedoes[/b]: A large, vital NATO convoy is approaching Europe with cargo and container ships as well as oil tankers. The Soviet Union has warned NATO that any further overseas reinforcement of Europe “will dramatically escalate the situation”. The Red Banner Fleet’s submarine force is gunning for the convoy en masse. How many will survive to reach the French coast?

9) [b]Fox Two[/b]: The Soviet bomber force is down for maintenance and re-arming, preparing for a big raid, and NATO intel suggests that the British Isles, so far unscathed from the carnage in continental Europe, are on the top of the target list. The Royal Air Force (RAF) is withdrawing from Norway and consolidating to protect the UK mainland. What will be the price of protecting the Crown?

10) [b]An Eye for an Eye[/b]: RAF bases have been hit with nuclear weapons. NATO does not want to escalate to all-out nuclear war, but Britain must respond in kind. The Ark Royal carrier group and its Buccaneer low-level strike aircraft will strike at the heart of Soviet Naval Aviation.

11) [b]Fire and Brimstone[/b]: The Saratoga and JFK carrier groups are tied down off the coast of Norway, supporting a desperate NATO holding action against advancing Soviet armor. This makes them perfect targets for Soviet missile bombers. Tactical nuclear weapons release has been granted. The all-out “bombers vs. carriers” battle that both sides have been rehearsing for over 20 years is about to explode.

12) [b]Hunter or Hunted[/b]: Both sides in the massive conflict are beginning to show signs of exhaustion. NATO carrier groups have been heavily damaged and forced to withdraw towards the GIUK gap, leaving subs and aircraft as the primary offensive assets. To bolster its own battered surface forces, the Soviet Navy is hurriedly commissioning and putting to sea the Kiev, its first real aircraft carrier. A trio of NATO nuclear submarines are hastily assembled to form the welcoming committee.

13) [b]Deliverance[/b]: The Soviet occupation of Iceland has been a constant problem for NATO planners. Soviet forces on the island have been repeatedly harassed but never truly neutralized. NATO now feels confident enough to seriously attempt to seize control of the island back. Multiple carrier groups and support forces, including the amphibious-modified USS Iowa, are converging on Iceland. But the Soviets will not hand over their most important outpost without a fight.

14) [b]Needle in a Hay Stack[/b]: BothSoviet and NATO strategic nuclear forces are being brought to a high state of readiness. The United States is now at DEFCON 2. Peace talks are at a stalemate after an attempted assassination on the US ambassador in Geneva. Unidentified submarines have been sighted off the coast of Nova Scotia. If Soviet submarines can roam in these waters, the US will be under constant threat of a sudden decapitation nuclear strike.

15) [b]Fail Safe[/b]: Amidst a terrible nuclear crisis, multiple cells of SAC B-52 bombers, armed with nuclear weapons, are reaching their “point of no return” locations over the Artic circle. Soviet strategic forces and air defences alike are in the highest alert level. Fingers rest on nuclear triggers. Can global thermonuclear war be averted?

notes.title: Command: Northern Inferno gets two Twitch Streams this Week!
notes.content:
Only few hours stand between you and World War III.

You don’t want to miss the chance to follow us as we stream the game on our official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel[/url] on the day of release at 20:00 CEST / 18:00 UTC / 2:00 PM EDT!

This Stream will be addressed mainly to anyone willing to learn more about the Command franchise and how to take the first steps into this monster, award-winning, game.

For the hardened veterans of [url=http://www.matrixgames.com/products/483/details/Command:.Modern.Air.Naval.Operations.Wargame.of.the.Year.Edition]Command: Modern Air / Naval Operation[/url], on the same day [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUNJdTKkZtkZIY5z7P2T8lg]Kushang Gaming[/url], will Stream Command: Northern Inferno at 3 AM CEST / 9 PM EDT / 6 PM PDT on its [url=http://www.twitch.tv/Kushan04]Twitch Channel[/url]!

Last but not least, the guys at Warfare Sims have prepared some extra information about the scenario you will find in Northern Inferno.

The game features a challenging campaign with 15 thrilling scenarios, or “Episodes”, describing a possible war between the Western Powers and Soviet Russia in the middle of the ‘70s. If you want to know more about what is coming, check [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/397180/announcements/detail/740073611860993149]here[/url].

Northern Inferno will release on October 22nd!
